extra.reason: Fixed on fix/bind-mark-to-review. review-pr now uses pr-cycle-start/pr-cycle-end against .claude/.review-pr-in-progress. The Stop gate honors both markers; only .review-in-progress licenses mark. 8 tests in stop-gate.bats pin the separation; verified end to end (pr-cycle-start then mark = exit 3, stop gate still passes).

Shipped on fix/bind-mark-to-review (4939a5d). mark requires the cycle-start marker; accept-state is the named human override; review-pr gets its own marker via pr-cycle-start/pr-cycle-end. Four review iterations, 397 tests (from 350), verified end to end here and independently on oakum. Follow-up cpl-dwq tracks making mark freshness-aware.
Fixed on fix/sentinel-union-hash: sentinel gains a union: line and check/match/status fall back to it when the index equals HEAD. 6 new bats cases; 403/403 green.

Fixed on fix/sentinel-enumeration-failure (PR #27, e6a0bff + b3833d2): every git call in the hash stream signals with exit 9, mapped to drift so hooks block; the stream is generated to a file and hashed separately so pipefail's rightmost-nonzero rule cannot mask the signal; build_scratch_index guards its rev-parse and ls-files calls. The block names the failing path and states that accept cannot clear it. 13 tests, each verified to fail against the previous release. Note: PR #27 is green and mergeable but NOT yet merged at close time.
